highlights.title: Wet Fabric
highlights.description: Fabric floats under water, soaks up water over time and hangs heavier once it leaves the water.

highlights.title: Wet Cling and Damping
highlights.description: Soaked fabric grips the body only where it touches it and stops springing back after leaving the water.

highlights.title: Stronger water
highlights.description: Pressure Strength and Tangential Drag let the flow push harder and pull garments along.
